title_zh: 诉求“掌上提” 难事“马上办”——拉萨市妇联依托“护蕾盾”平台织密妇女儿童权益守护网
title_en: Appeals via Mobile, Problems Solved Promptly: Lhasa Women's Federation Builds 'Guardian Bud Shield' Platform to Protect Women's and Children's Rights
summary_zh: 拉萨市妇联依托“护蕾盾”平台，让妇女儿童的诉求可“掌上提”、难事“马上办”，进一步织密妇女儿童权益保护网络。
summary_en: The Lhasa Women's Federation is using its 'Guardian Bud Shield' platform so that women and children can submit appeals by mobile phone and have difficulties handled promptly, tightening the network protecting their rights.
